project.name: Paper Boat
project.character: A handmade white paper sailboat with a small blue pencil stripe
project.environment: A shallow puddle bordered by moss and small garden stones after rain
project.style: Natural macro photography, warm daylight, gentle shallow depth of field

passes.prompt: Track the paper sailboat from water level as it drifts past a tiny leaf. Ripples lap against the paper and distant birds sing.
Continuing the gentle tracking move, the sailboat rounds a smooth gray stone into a ribbon of sunlight. Keep quiet water and birdsong.
